title: Weights & Caches: LLMs Can Program Tabular Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.20174v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural networks are typically programmed through optimization, rather than by explicitly specifying their computations. Recent work on weight-space programming suggests that large language models (LLMs) can instead reason about and manipulate neural-network weights directly. In this work, we show that LLMs can directly program statistical computations in tabular foundation models (TFMs), whose parameters enable inference across different datasets. We investigate three complementary settings using GPT-6 Astra, without gradient-based optimization. First, Astra directly programs nanoTabPFN from zero-initialized weights, achieving a mean ROC AUC of 0.849 across 20 TabArena datasets, compared to 0.876 for a pretrained baseline. Second, Astra diagnoses and repairs a signed-product regression failure in pretrained TabPFN-3.5, restoring near-perfect predictions on held-out synthetic datasets while preserving performance on TabArena-Lite, with on

translated_title: 权重与缓存：大语言模型能够对表格基础模型进行编程
translated_abstract: 神经网络通常是通过优化过程来“编程”的，而不是通过显式指定其计算方式。近期关于权重空间编程的研究表明，大语言模型（LLMs）可以直接对神经网络的权重进行推理和操作。在这项工作中，我们证明大语言模型可以直接对表格基础模型（TFMs）中的统计计算进行编程，此类模型的参数支持跨不同数据集的推理。我们使用 GPT-6 Astra 研究了三种互补的设置，且不依赖基于梯度的优化。首先，Astra 从零初始化的权重出发直接对 nanoTabPFN 进行编程，在 20 个 TabArena 数据集上取得了 0.849 的平均 ROC AUC，而预训练基线为 0.876。其次，Astra 诊断并修复了预训练 TabPFN-3.5 中符号乘积回归的失败问题，在留出的合成数据集上恢复了近乎完美的预测，同时保持了在 TabArena-Lite 上的性能……
tldr: 大语言模型 GPT-6 Astra 无需梯度优化即可直接对表格基础模型的权重进行编程，既能从零构建接近预训练基线性能的表格预测模型，也能诊断并修复预训练模型中的缺陷。
en_tdlr: LLMs (GPT-6 Astra) can directly program tabular foundation model weights without gradient-based optimization, both building functional tabular predictors from scratch and diagnosing and repairing defects in pretrained models.
